The base is connected to +UCC through Rb1 and to ground through Rb2, forming voltage-divider bias; the collector is connected to +UCC through Rc; the emitter is grounded through Re and has bypass capacitor Ce; the input is applied to the base through coupling capacitor C1, and the output is connected to load RL through coupling capacitor C2. claims.source: The base is connected to +UCC through Rb1 and to ground through Rb2, forming voltage-divider bias

claims.claim: The collector is connected to +UCC through Rc.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: The collector is connected to +UCC through Rc

claims.claim: The emitter is grounded through Re.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: The emitter is grounded through Re

claims.claim: The emitter has bypass capacitor Ce.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: And has bypass capacitor Ce

claims.claim: The input is applied to the base through coupling capacitor C1.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: The input is applied to the base through coupling capacitor C1

claims.claim: The output is connected to load RL through coupling capacitor C2.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: The output is connected to load RL through coupling capacitor C2

claims.claim: When finding the DC quiescent operating point, C1, C2, and Ce are all treated as open circuits.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: When finding the DC quiescent operating point, C1, C2, and Ce are all treated as open circuits

claims.claim: RL does not participate in the DC calculation.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Therefore RL does not participate in the DC calculation

claims.claim: The emitter DC path still passes through Re.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The emitter DC path still passes through Re

claims.claim: The base voltage-divider voltage is approximately VB = UCC·Rb2/(Rb1+Rb2) = 12×40/(80+40) = 4 V.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The base voltage-divider voltage is approximately VB = UCC·Rb2/(Rb1+Rb2) = 12×40/(80+40) = 4 V

claims.claim: UBEQ≈0 is a known condition.
claims.label: perception
claims.source: It is known that UBEQ≈0

claims.claim: It is known that UBEQ≈0, so VE≈VB≈4 V.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: It is known that UBEQ≈0, so VE≈VB≈4 V

claims.claim: IE≈VE/Re = 4 V / 2 kΩ = 2 mA。
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Thus IE≈VE/Re = 4 V / 2 kΩ = 2 mA

claims.claim: Approximately IC≈IE≈2 mA.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Approximately IC≈IE≈2 mA

claims.claim: The collector voltage VC≈UCC−ICRc = 12 V − 2 mA×2 kΩ = 8 V.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: The collector voltage VC≈UCC−ICRc = 12 V − 2 mA×2 kΩ = 8 V

claims.claim: UCEQ = VC−VE ≈ 8 V − 4 V = 4 V。
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Therefore UCEQ = VC−VE ≈ 8 V − 4 V = 4 V
